title: Co-funded Research Grants – Short-Term Grants - DAAD
summary: Short-term research grants in Germany for Brazilian doctoral candidates who hold a domestic scholarship from CAPES or a participating state foundation.

subject_areas.notes: All subject areas are eligible; language requirements vary by subject.

institutions.notes: A state or state-recognised institution of higher education or a non-university research institute in Germany.

nationality.notes: Applicants must be at a university in Brazil and hold a domestic scholarship from CAPES or a participating FAP.

residence.notes: Applicants must not have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

mandatory.text: Applicants must hold official status as a doctoral candidate at a university in Brazil.
Must have been awarded a domestic scholarship from CAPES or one of the participating FAPs.
As a rule, applicants should not have achieved the last university degree any longer than six years before the application deadline.
Start of the doctorate should not be more than 3 years prior to the date of application.
Must not have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

funding.description: Monthly payment of € 890, payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover, and travel allowance (unless covered by home country or another source). For co-funding via CAPES or FAPs, domestic doctoral scholarships are paid during the research stay without changing duration and value.
funding.duration: 2 months to a maximum of six months

application_rounds.notes: Selection date in March 2027. Source specifies Central European seasonal time. Unnormalised source clock time: 24.00.

recurring_deadline_notes: Application deadlines are updated at least once a year. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
List of publications (max. 10 pages), if applicable
Extensive and detailed description of the research proposal agreed upon with the academic adviser and description of previous research work (max. 10 pages)
Proof of enrolment in home university, with the entrance date
Letter confirming supervision by an academic adviser in Germany
All university degree certificates obtained to date
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects of the research project
Proof of the scholarship award stating the funding period issued by CAPES or one of the participating FAPs
Official language certificate of German or English proficiency
Transcripts of Records on all annual examinations with individual grade(s), incl. explanation of grading system
German or English translations of documents submitted in the national language
One recent supporting letter of recommendation (on a DAAD-form) from a university teacher

steps.text: Request recommendation form in the DAAD Portal and have it completed by a university teacher
Prepare application documents and translate if necessary
Fill out the application form and upload application documents in PDF format to the portal

sources.title: Co-funded Research Grants – Short-Term Grants - DAAD - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme funds international doctoral candidates from Brazil for physical research stays in Germany.
